highlights.reason_zh: 价格足以改变高频 agent 的路由成本，但权重与独立评测尚未到位。
highlights.reason_en: Pricing can change routing economics for high-volume agents, while weights and independent evaluation are still missing.

highlights.reason_zh: 特定功能组合可能静默恢复错误状态，生产升级前必须先做正确性回归。
highlights.reason_en: A feature combination could silently resume the wrong state, requiring a correctness regression before production upgrade.

highlights.reason_zh: 冻结 workspace 缩小子 agent 写权限，但托管恢复路径更复杂，需要故障注入。
highlights.reason_en: Frozen workspaces reduce child-agent write authority, while the broader managed recovery surface needs fault injection.

highlights.reason_zh: 命令范围延伸到第三方 DeepSeek 实现；联邦供应链团队需要盘点，但不能泛化为全面禁令。
highlights.reason_en: The order reaches third-party DeepSeek implementations, requiring a federal supply-chain inventory without generalizing it into a universal ban.

highlights.reason_zh: 原生 PyTorch backend 可能降低 Trainium 迁移成本，但源码尚未开放，当前只能等待核验。
highlights.reason_en: A native PyTorch backend could lower Trainium migration cost, but source is not yet public and verification must wait.

coverage_zh: 36/36 个固定入口抓取并读完；主动检索补充中文与印尼语材料、小团队、开放权重、研究、基础设施、政策和重大综合新闻。MiniMax 数据为厂商自报；TorchNeuron 源码尚未开放；DHS 本轮公开的是 7 月已生效命令。周末 arXiv 无严格窗口内新投稿，到期复核没有改变判断。 召回自检确认 HybridAgent 已于 10 月 14 日入库，并把 DeepSeek 1017 的独立 API 评测写回原事件。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed; active discovery added Chinese- and Indonesian-language material, small teams, open weights, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. MiniMax figures are vendor-reported; TorchNeuron source was not yet public; DHS newly disclosed an order effective since July. The weekend arXiv feed had no strictly in-window submission, and due reviews changed no judgment. Recall audit confirmed HybridAgent was already cataloged on October 14 and added the independent DeepSeek 1017 API evaluation to the existing event.
